name: a school lab seen from the side: a tiled wall with a shelf of jars, a wall clock and a globe poster, a long bench with drawers, and on the bench a drinking glass, a teaspoon, a big glass tank and a two-pan balance
fits: a comparison of tiny and huge amounts shown with everyday water: a glass, a spoon, a tank standing for the ocean, a balance; anything counted in molecules, moles or litres; the hero is the glass of water
recipe: flat 2D front view (no iso): a tile wall that bleeds past the frame with faint grout lines, a shelf with two-tone jars, a round wall clock with a moving hand, a poster with a flat globe; a bench top with a front face and drawers; on it a glass with water full of H2O molecule dots, a teaspoon, a tall tank filled with rows of tiny glasses (a pattern revealed from the bottom) and a balance whose beam tilts toward the heavier count
